title: Perfect-ish scores
statementMd:
List enrollments (student id, course id) with a score of at least 98.

Expected columns: `student_id`, `course_id`, `score`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT student_id, course_id, score FROM enrollments WHERE score >= 98;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
